title: Think Before You Transcribe: Context-Steered Reasoning for Hotword-Aware Speech Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2610.26986v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Contextual automatic speech recognition (ASR) improves rare-entity recognition by supplying candidate hotwords, but retrieved candidates may be incomplete or incorrect. A reliable system must therefore exploit a relevant candidate without allowing unsupported alternatives to override the acoustic evidence. We propose a context-steered reasoning framework that generates a short, audio-grounded caption before transcription. This task-specific representation lets the model assess candidate relevance before making a lexical decision. Supervised fine-tuning establishes the structured caption-to-transcription behavior, while targeted trajectory injection strengthens group relative policy optimization when difficult utterances yield only unsuccessful rollouts. translated_title: 先思考再转录：面向热词感知语音识别的上下文引导推理
translated_abstract: 上下文自动语音识别（ASR）通过提供候选热词来改善罕见实体的识别，但检索到的候选词可能不完整或不正确。因此，一个可靠的系统必须能够利用相关的候选词，同时防止缺乏依据的备选词覆盖声学证据。我们提出了一种上下文引导的推理框架，在转录之前先生成简短的、基于音频的描述。这种任务特定的表示使模型能够在做出词汇决策之前评估候选词的相关性。监督微调建立了从描述到转录的结构化行为，而当困难语音只产生不成功的推演结果时，有针对性的轨迹注入增强了组相对策略优化（GRPO）。在多种上下文条件下的实验表明，所提出的方法在保持对无关上下文鲁棒性的同时，持续提升了转录质量和热词识别效果。
tldr: 该论文提出一种上下文引导的推理框架，通过在转录前先生成基于音频的简短描述来评估热词候选的相关性，从而在多种上下文条件下同时提升语音识别的转录质量和热词识别准确率，并对无关上下文保持鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a context-steered reasoning framework that generates a short audio-grounded caption before transcription to assess hotword candidate relevance, consistently improving both transcription quality and hotword recognition while remaining robust to irrelevant contexts.
